import http.server,http.client,threading,json
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
 def do_GET(self):
  self.send_response(200);self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(b'ok')
server=http.server.HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,kwargs={'poll_interval':0.01});thread.start()
try:
 client=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',server.server_port,timeout=2);client.request('GET','/submit');response=client.getresponse();body=response.read();status=response.status;client.close()
finally:server.shutdown();thread.join();server.server_close()
print(status)
